Approve this installation with an indexer.

USAGE
  sennit connect --out <file> [flags]

FLAGS
  --out file          File to write the issued app key to, created 0600
                      (required)
  --indexer url       Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --wait duration     How long to keep a live approval link available (default
                      30m)
  --ready duration    How long to wait for the account to become usable
                      (default 90s)

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when        When to colour output: auto, always or never (default
                      auto)

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit connect --out sennit.key
  $ export SENNIT_APP_KEY="$(cat sennit.key)"

The recovery phrase comes from SENNIT_PHRASE, or from stdin when that is unset.
